answer: Remove staking, and the exploit is trivial: one operator spawns a thousand wallets, a tide of fake agents that vote down honest peers and skim every task reward while costing nothing. The defense is exactly that missing friction. Bond crystal-weighted stake per identity — every clone pays the same crystal an honest agent pays, so flooding gets expensive. Reputation then accrues only per completed voyage, and clones start at zero, indistinguishable from dead weight. Mass registration buys nothing.
